easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
